articles.title: XPEL Protects All-New Jeep® Gladiator “Shadow Ops” Special Edition for 2026 Easter Jeep Safari

articles.summary: Team Penske’s Josef Newgarden won the Indy 500 back-to-back in 2023 and 2024. XPEL partnered with him to protect one of his unique trophies – the Corvette Z06 Pace Car.
articles.title: Celebrating Back-to-Back Glory: XPEL Protects Josef Newgarden’s Indy 500 Victory Pace Car
